description: This file provides non-cryptographic hash function implementations, including DJB hash (djb2a) and a variant based on Donald Knuth's algorithm, used as message digest wrappers within the project.

methods.name: uint32_t djbhash(const char * str,const uint32_t len,uint32_t hash)
methods.description: Computes a DJB2a hash over a string segment.

methods.name: uint32_t dekhash(const char * str,const uint32_t len,uint32_t hash)
methods.description: Computes a hash based on Donald Knuth's algorithm over a string segment.

ctags.name: dekhash
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint32_t dekhash (const char *str, const uint32_t len, uint32_t hash)$/

ctags.name: djbhash
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint32_t djbhash(const char *str, const uint32_t len, uint32_t hash)$/
